name: Engineering University of the CAPF
zh: 中国人民武装警察部队工程大学
aliases: Engineering University of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force

evidence.summary: NDU’s study of the People’s Armed Police lists PAP Engineering University among the force’s universities and academies, and CASI’s translation of the PLA’s 2024 recruitment plan lists it among the four PAP academies that admitted officer cadets that year. Under the Central Military Commission’s 2025 admissions plan it is one of the two PAP academies still admitting school-leavers, and it now also takes cadets for coast guard vessel-command and law-enforcement posts.
The university belongs to the PAP, which since the reforms of 2017–2018 has answered to the Central Military Commission alone.
